headline: Site plans approved for 0 Grafton Street, 6 Woburn Street, 70 Summerhill Avenue, and 35 and 37 State Road; street petitions recommended.
summary: Approved site plans for four projects, including 0 Grafton Street, which will have two 12-unit apartment buildings. Recommended that Midgley Avenue and Esper Avenue become public streets. Continued the site plan for 23 Everton Street to November 18, 2026.
decisions: Moved the December 9, 2026 meeting to December 16, 2026, 4-0.
Continued public hearings for 29 Firglade Street, 256 & 262 Sunderland Road, 1 & 3 Suburban Road, and 20-22 Goldthwaite Road, 4-0.
Continued the site plan for 23 Everton Street to November 18, 2026, 4-0.
Approved the definitive site plan for 6 Woburn Street (also called 10 Woburn Street) with condition 1K removed; three yes votes were called.
Approved the site plan, parking special permit, and more-than-one-building approval for 0 Grafton Street, 4-0.
Approved the definitive site plan for 70 Summerhill Avenue with amended conditions; three yes votes were called.
Approved the definitive site plan and more-than-one-building approval for 35 and 37 State Road, 4-0.
Recommended to City Council that Midgley Avenue (priority level one) and Esper Avenue (priority level two) become public streets, 4-0.
Endorsed ANR plans 12B and 12C for 22 New York Street and 134 Massasoit Road, 4-0.
discussion: Sidewalk replacement at 0 Grafton Street: Members discussed whether to require new concrete sidewalks and granite curbing. The applicant said the work would cost about $50,000 and was not a site plan requirement, and the board kept the condition to match its recent practice.
23 Everton Street drain line: A surface drain line may cross the site, and the house may need to move. The applicant agreed to continue the item to fix the question.
Esper and Midgley street petitions: Residents described washed-out dirt roads, large potholes, and emergency access problems. A land trust letter asked to be exempt from any betterment charge.
State Road lighting: Staff asked for a photometric plan and questioned the parking lot lighting. The applicant agreed to provide one, and trash totes would be emptied by a private hauler.
6 Woburn Street lighting: Members discussed whether a revised lighting plan was needed for the rear parking spaces. They removed the condition because the site has little night use.
